subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the conflicting open fork PR or allow a fresh target-repo fix for the active Telegram approval runtime?
rationale: Automation should not queue a duplicate fix while an open closing-reference fork PR exists, but that fork PR is not a clean or maintainer-modifiable landing path.

options.title: Replace with a narrow target-repo fix
options.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and land a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Manually adopt the useful idea
options.body: Cherry-pick only the active-runtime final-action shape from the prior same-repo/fork work and discard the obsolete handler and unrelated docs edits.

options.title: Wait on the fork PR
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on a conflicting, unmodifiable fork branch that currently does not target the active runtime path.

recommendation.title: Replace with a narrow target-repo fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the fork PR and land a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns the native approval lifecycle seam introduced in the refactor authored by this contributor.
